newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks rise but end below day's highs.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks rise but end below day's highs.

text.p: Argentine stocks rose Tuesday, but the market finished way below session highs trailing a decline on Wall Street.
The blue-chip Merval stock index ended the session 1.49 percent higher at 666.3 points after having risen as much as 2.60 percent earlier in the day.

"After the favorable reaction to the U.S. labor cost index the market continued to be volatile as if confirming the possibility of another pull-back in prices ahead of more U.S. indicators," said Jorge Bonanno, a trader at Interfin brokers.
"In what remains of the week, the market is set to consolidate, with a support level for the Merval at 660/650 points," said Bonanno.
Of the 69 stocks traded this session, 48 rose, 10 fell and 11 were unchanged.
Among top performers were automaker Sevel and Banco Bansud, both rising 4.0 percent.
Trade volume rose to 22.8 million pesos from 15.2 million pesos on Monday. ((--Walter Bianchi, Buenos Aires Newsroom, 541 318-0633))
